question: I got so excited when Luffy's new Gear 5 techniques Gomu Gomu no Dawn Rocket and Dawn Whip were named! But when I see the word "white", I naturally think "panties" - that would be even more exciting! Why is it read "dawn" instead? ("Dawn" here is written with the kanji for "white", but the pronunciation "dawn".)
answer: Wait! Ramen-maru!? Your spray scared away Sanada, but did you just summon another weirdo!? What do you mean "when you see 'white', you think 'panties'"!? PTA members, it's not what it sounds like! It isn't that kind of manga!!
name: Ijikko
